_about: The one budget table the admission harness reads (ROADMAP B701, ADR-401 rulings 1-4, ADR-359 r1). Per-corner bytes, counting what the module writes, measured its own way; horde's wrapper and the basis go to the open ceiling, not here. It mirrors the table under the state-budget-table marker in docs/proposals/rack-slot-contract.md §12.9, row for row (module, bytes, counted figure, status); tools/state_budget_check.py in ./verify fast is red when the two differ. `counts` is the counted figure as the harness can measure it: patch-text where the contract's cell names the patch text, state where the cell reads 'its state', own for a measure the module's adapter must supply (A19 fails no-measure until it does). Keys: tools/admission_check.py's MODULES keys where a module has an adapter (scape, kiln-eq, kiln-drive), a stable lowercase key otherwise. Change a figure only by a ruling, in the contract and here in one PR.
